prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Soil water balance modelling using daily precipitation and evapotranspiration inputs has been applied to estimate groundwater recharge across Vojvodina using the Penman–Monteith equation for evapotranspiration calculation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03044","field":"abstract","quote":"Recharge was strongly correlated with autumn precipitation totals and inversely correlated with summer evapotranspiration computed by the Penman–Monteith equation"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03051","field":"abstract","quote":"a daily soil water balance model driven by statistically downscaled outputs from five CMIP6 general circulation models"}]},{"text":"Spatial soil heterogeneity and soil texture effects on water-holding capacity and recharge have been quantified through analysis of multiple soil types and monitoring networks across Vojvodina.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03051","field":"abstract","quote":"Baseline mean annual recharge across the study domain was estimated at 43 mm/yr depending on soil texture and land use"}]},{"text":"Field validation of water balance calculations has been conducted using dense piezometer networks and water-table hydrographs to separate hydraulic responses from different water sources during irrigation seasons.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03049","field":"abstract","quote":"Water-table hydrographs were decomposed to separate canal-recharge signals from precipitation-driven responses during the 2018 and 2019 irrigation seasons"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has demonstrated direct expertise in soil water balance modelling using Penman–Monteith evapotranspiration [SYN-PUB-03044], calibration against observed field data across Vojvodina [SYN-PUB-03051], and validation using piezometer networks during irrigation seasons [SYN-PUB-03049], which directly addresses the challenge's core requirement to build and validate an evapotranspiration-coupled water-balance engine for irrigation scheduling."}
